✨ Designers × AI

🆕 The mockup era is over. Today’s AI tools give every designer a superpower: you can now craft your ideas, not just draw them. 

The gap between “what if…?” and “look, it works!” has never been smaller, and that changed how we build features in Telegram.

Message @designers (https://t.me/designers) to submit your concepts.

✔️ We accept
– Working, ready-to-implement code
 complemented by
– A demo video of your feature in action

🗑 We no longer accept
– Static mockups
– Demo videos with no code behind them
– Text-only concepts

No coding background? Curiosity, attention to detail and a good prompt will take you far. 

The future of design isn’t drawn – it’s built. 

🚀 Let's build it together!

(An example of what is possible by our iOS designer – this is a ready to use implementation not a motion video.) 👇
💸 If your wallet doesn’t look like this, don’t even bother sending me money for my  birthday! 🎂

🤝 Telegram has become the sponsor of Codeforces (https://codeforces.com/blog/entry/156620) — the largest competitive programming platform in the world. 

 ⚡CodeForces organizes over 100 coding contests every year and has 4 million contestants signed up.

🌱 Since 2010, I've supported Codeforces through the companies I started.

🆙 But this year will be special. Its founder Mike wants to bring Codeforces to the next level — and we'll be happy to help him do that 🤝
